test_cases.name: Basic ASCII Typing and Readback
test_cases.setup: Controller initialized in IDLE state; desktop target.
test_cases.expected_result: All characters dispatched via SendInput with 0 errors; state returns to IDLE.

test_cases.name: Unicode, UTF-16 & Non-BMP Handling
test_cases.setup: Unicode decomposition into UTF-16 surrogate pairs, viramas, and variation selectors.
test_cases.action: Dispatched 105 Unicode characters (107 UTF-16 code units).
test_cases.expected_result: Surrogate pairs and Devanagari grapheme clusters correctly formatted and dispatched.
test_cases.actual_observation: Outcome: EXACT_MATCH, Exact Match: True, NFC Match: True.
test_cases.limitations: Full grapheme cluster rendering verified via UTF-16 surrogate pair decomposition.

test_cases.name: Modifier Shortcut Reliability
test_cases.setup: Phased 4-step shortcut engine (Mod Down -> Key Down -> Key Up -> Mod Up).
test_cases.action: Executed 7 standard editing shortcuts including multi-modifier combinations.
test_cases.expected_result: Shortcuts execute cleanly and release all modifiers (0 stuck modifier keys).
test_cases.actual_observation: Shortcuts executed: 7, Orbit Keys Depressed Remaining: 0.

test_cases.name: Special-Key Behavior & Extended Keys
test_cases.setup: Virtual Key & Extended Key mapping for navigation and whitespace keys.
test_cases.action: Dispatched 13 individual special and extended keys.
test_cases.expected_result: All keys mapped to correct VK/extended flags; 0 stuck keys.

test_cases.name: Long Text Streaming
test_cases.expected_result: Full stream delivered without memory leak, deadlock, or dropped code units.
test_cases.limitations: Measured throughput across sustained multi-thousand character payload.

test_cases.name: Cancellation During Typing
test_cases.setup: Active typing stream interrupted mid-flight via CancellationRequest(HUMAN_TAKEOVER).
test_cases.action: Measured explicit separated latency metrics A, B, C, D, E.
test_cases.expected_result: Worker halts immediately; state = PAUSED_BY_USER; 0 stuck keys; explicit latencies recorded.
test_cases.actual_observation: Halted after 11 chars. Propagation (A): 501.9µs, Worker Term (B): 562.8µs, Sanitization (C): 25.0µs.
test_cases.limitations: Metric E marked NOT FULLY MEASURABLE due to destination application timestamp limits.

test_cases.name: Cancellation During Shortcut Phases
test_cases.setup: ORBIT holding Ctrl+Shift when cancellation is issued mid-phase.
test_cases.action: Triggered sanitization while multiple modifiers were recorded in down-state.
test_cases.expected_result: All active ORBIT-owned modifiers cleanly released; state manager returns to 0 depressed keys.
test_cases.limitations: Guarantees 0 stuck modifier keys when aborted at any shortcut phase.

test_cases.name: Human Takeover Integration Contract
test_cases.expected_result: Sink receives signal without direct source-code coupling to Prototype B.

test_cases.name: Target Invalid Before Execution
test_cases.setup: Target HWND set to non-existent or background window handle (0xDEADBEEF).
test_cases.action: Pre-dispatch verification checks IsWindow() and foreground focus prior to character dispatch.
test_cases.expected_result: Target invalidity detected; aborts before dispatch; state = SAFE_ABORT; 0 chars sent.
test_cases.limitations: TOCTOU race window documented between validation and physical dispatch.

test_cases.name: Focus Loss During Execution
test_cases.setup: Focus shifts away from target window during active execution.
test_cases.action: Fast check detects foreground mismatch and signals immediate SAFE_ABORT.
test_cases.expected_result: Action halts without injecting characters to newly focused window.
test_cases.actual_observation: State transitions to SAFE_ABORT; cancellation source: FOCUS_LOSS.
test_cases.limitations: Re-check validation halted stream immediately upon focus loss notification.

test_cases.name: Target Destruction During Execution
test_cases.setup: Target HWND closed or destroyed during active operation.
test_cases.action: IsWindow(hwnd) verification checks handle lifecycle before every dispatch.
test_cases.expected_result: Destroyed handle detected; triggers TARGET_LOSS and SAFE_ABORT.
test_cases.limitations: Prevents blind SendInput to recycled or closed Win32 window handles.

test_cases.name: Post-Cancellation Injection Boundary
test_cases.setup: Measure SendInput events occurring after cancellation observation.
test_cases.expected_result: Counter is strictly 0 (no keystrokes dispatched once cancellation is observed).
test_cases.limitations: Distinguishes application-side SendInput calls from destination-side OS message delivery.

test_cases.name: Multi-Application Compatibility Matrix
test_cases.setup: Multi-tier runtime capability detection across 4 application tiers.
test_cases.action: Evaluated Tkinter Widget, Notepad, RichEdit (runtime detected), and Browser DOM Harness.
test_cases.expected_result: Independent reporting format maintained without cross-tier result extrapolation.
test_cases.actual_observation: Tier 1: PASS, Tier 2: PASS, Tier 3: SKIPPED — ENVIRONMENT LIMITATION, Tier 4: PASS.
test_cases.limitations: Tier 3 dynamically skipped when write.exe/wordpad is unavailable on modern Windows 11 builds.

test_cases.name: Shared Logical Keys & Emergency Stop Contract
test_cases.setup: ORBIT holds Ctrl (ORBIT_INJECTED_TRACKED); User holds Shift (USER_PHYSICAL_OBSERVED).
test_cases.action: Triggered selective sanitization of ORBIT session and verified E-Stop contract.
test_cases.expected_result: ORBIT releases ONLY its own Ctrl key; User-owned Shift key is NEVER released.
test_cases.actual_observation: Sanitized: 1 ORBIT key, Untouched User Keys: 1.
test_cases.limitations: Documents merged user32 logical keystate boundary while enforcing non-destructive selective release.
